# Cincy crash data
```{r cincy_crashes}
crashes_per_day=30125/365
crashes_per_day

crashes_by_day = c(2020L, 2241L, 2327L, 2285L,
                   2380L, 1866L, 1664L)
names(crashes_by_day) = c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu",
                          "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")
crashes_by_day

crashes_by_day > 2100

sum(crashes_by_day > 2000)   # days above 2,000

mean(crashes_by_day)

typeof(TRUE)     # logical
typeof(401L)     # integer: the L
typeof(401)      # double: no L
typeof("401")    # character: quotes
```
